 Samay Raina Comes to BGMI With 10 Mission Bus Challenge From 9 December
 BGMI 
 Krafton India is bringing Samay Raina to BGMI with an avatar and a comedy-themed bus.
 The event runs from 9 December 2026 to 18 January 2027 on Erangel and Livik.
 Players complete 10 missions in order to earn tokens and a "CRAZYY" achievement.
 Items include the Samay Raina Crazzy Set, a Banana Man outfit and a DP-28 skin.
 Divyesh Moghe 
 16 Nov 2026, 5:56 PM IST 
 1 min. read 
 Facebook X WhatsApp Telegram Copy URL 
 Add as preferred source 
 Krafton India announced on 16 November that comedian Samay Raina is coming to Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) as part of the 4.7 update. A Samay Raina avatar and a comedy-themed bus will appear in the game from 9 December 2026 to 18 January 2027. Players will complete a chain of 10 daily missions tied to the bus. The collaboration arrives three weeks after the 4.7 update itself goes live on 18 November.
 The Samay Raina Bus will spawn at 10 locations across Erangel and Livik. It will appear in Theme and Classic modes, in both Ranked and Unranked matches. Krafton India said the experience will not be available in Erangel Subzero.
 How the Samay Raina Bus missions work in BGMI
 Players find the bus on the map and collect a mission from Samay Raina, who also performs short comedy acts. The missions unlock one at a time, so a player must finish each mission before moving to the next. Completing them earns tokens and unlocks an achievement that Krafton India calls “CRAZYY”. The publisher said a further surprise waits at the end of the chain but has not said what it is.
 - Advertisement - 
 Krafton India linked the missions to “one video a day, one mission a day” in its announcement. It has not said where the daily videos will be published or how many tokens each mission gives. More details will follow on BGMI’s official YouTube, Instagram and Facebook channels.
 Samay Raina collaboration items in BGMI 4.7
 The collaboration adds the following items to the game:

 Samay Raina Crazzy Set
 Crazzy Siren Emote
 Special Voice Pack
 Banana Man
 Puppet Skin
 Party popper backpack
 Crazzy parachute
 DP-28 gun skin
 Krafton India has not said which items players earn through the missions and which will be sold in the in-game store. Prices for paid items have not been disclosed.
 The 4.7 update, due on 18 November, brings the Arctic Chronicles theme mode to BGMI. Krafton India is also preparing BGMI Air , a lighter version of the game, for players on lower-end phones. BGMI has passed 260 million downloads, and full details of the 4.7 update are on the official BGMI website .
